profile.name: ACQ1102高速数据采集系统
profile.description: ACQ1102是一类面向实验室测量与控制的高速数据采集设备，可用于多通道瞬态信号采集、连续数据流监测、触发前后波形记录以及同步时钟/触发路由。结合校准、分段采集、数字输出和波形/脉冲序列加载功能，它适合物理实验、脉冲功率、装置联调和其他需要精确定时的数据记录场景。
profile.description_en: The ACQ1102 is a high-speed laboratory data acquisition instrument for multi-channel transient capture, live data streaming, pre/post-trigger waveform recording, and synchronized clock/trigger routing. With calibration handling, segmented acquisition, digital outputs, and waveform or pulse-sequence loading, it is suited to physics experiments, pulsed-power setups, system integration, and other precisely timed measurement tasks.
